title: carrick.status/0
description: Output of `carrick status --json`: what the local index holds for a WORKSPACE, with no file in the question. Its own schema rather than a fileless form of carrick.check/0, so every response there stays about one file. Prose: docs/local-mode-output.md. Fields may be added; none is renamed or removed without notice.

workspace.description: Absolute path of the folder holding carrick-workspace.json and .carrick/.

indexed_at.description: RFC 3339 time the last index or refresh finished.

scanner_version.description: Scanner release that wrote the index.

repos.description: One entry per indexed repo, for what changed in it that no service reads. Absent on an answer written before this field existed.

running_scans.description: Builds started with `carrick index --detach` that are running now, or stopped without finishing. Absent in the ordinary case.

scan_id.description: Also the name of .carrick/scan-<id>.log, and the head of the run id the scan logs under.

started_at.description: RFC 3339. Elapsed time is computed from it, never stored.

infer.description: Whether this is the paid pass.

progress.description: The last count the scan reported inside that phase.

name.description: Its directory name, which is what the index keys blobs by.

changed_since_index.description: Everything in the repo that differs from the indexed commit or that git does not track, services included.

outside_every_service.description: How many of those no service in this repo reads.

stale_files.description: Up to 50 of THOSE, repo-relative and sorted.

service.description: serviceName from carrick.json, else the repo name.

repo.description: Absolute path of the repo this service belongs to. Services of one repo share a commit; each states its own changed-file count.

changed_since_index.description: Exact count of files THIS SERVICE's scan reads — its directory and its include roots — that differ from index_commit or that git does not track. What no service reads is on the repo entry.

stale_files.description: Up to 50 of them, repo-relative and sorted.

stale_files_total.description: Always the exact number, whatever the list length.

stale_files_truncated.description: Whether stale_files is a sample rather than the whole set.

boundary_lines.description: The boundary as the CLI prints it. Print these bytes rather than re-wording the struct.

error.description: Exit code is 0 anyway: a read-only command never fails a session.

running_scans.description: Carried on the error body too: "there is no index" and "one is being built right now" are different answers, and a reader given only the first starts a second scan.
